translationRepairs: On wushen he encamped at Hulunbuir; Mahamu attacked in force and was shattered; the pursuit ran to the Tula River before Mahamu escaped under cover of night.
On wushen he encamped at Hulanhushiwén; Mahamu attacked in force and was shattered; the pursuit ran to the Tula River before Mahamu escaped under cover of night.
忽蘭忽失溫 is the Mongolian toponym Hulanhushiwén near the Tula River, not Hulunbuir in Manchuria.
On wushen he halted at Hulunbuir; Mahamu led masses to attack and was greatly defeated; pursuit reached the Tula River and Mahamu fled by night.
On wushen he halted at Hulanhushiwén; Mahamu led masses to attack and was greatly defeated; pursuit reached the Tula River and Mahamu fled by night.
Literal English likewise wrongly renders 忽蘭忽失溫 as Hulunbuir.
On gengshen, 479,000-odd shi of rent on flood-stricken fields in Suzhou, Songjiang, Hangzhou, Jiaxing, and Huguang was remitted.
On gengshen, 479,000-odd shi of rent on flood-stricken fields in Suzhou, Songjiang, Hangzhou, Jiaxing, and Huzhou was remitted.
湖 here is Huzhou (湖州), not Huguang; the idiomatic 'lake districts' is vague but the literal Huguang is wrong.
In the seventh month of autumn, on maoyin, Zheng He came back from the sea.
In the seventh month of autumn, on guimao, Zheng He came back from the sea.
癸卯 is guimao, not maoyin (which would be 戊寅).
Autumn, seventh month, on maoyin, Zheng He returned.
Autumn, seventh month, on guimao, Zheng He returned.
Literal English also misreads 癸卯 as maoyin.
On bis the Shanduzhang tribes of Rong County in Sichuan were subdued.
On yisi the Shanduzhang tribes of Rong County in Sichuan were subdued.
乙巳 is yisi; 'bis' is not a valid sexagenary day reading.
On bis, the Shanduzhang Miao of Rong County in Sichuan were pacified.
On yisi, the Shanduzhang Miao of Rong County in Sichuan were pacified.
Literal English likewise fails to render 乙巳 as yisi.
On jiawu Fei Ying was stationed in Gansu and Liu Jiang in Liaodong.
On jiawu Fei Huan was stationed in Gansu and Liu Jiang in Liaodong.
費瓛 is Fei Huan (瓛 = huán), not Fei Ying.
On jiawu, Fei Ying garrisoned Gansu and Liu Jiang garrisoned Liaodong.
On jiawu, Fei Huan garrisoned Gansu and Liu Jiang garrisoned Liaodong.
Literal English should likewise romanize 瓛 as Huan.
On bis Ji Gang, commander of the Embroidered-Uniform Guard, was put to death for his offenses.
On yisi Ji Gang, commander of the Embroidered-Uniform Guard, was put to death for his offenses.
乙巳 is yisi; 'bis' is not a valid sexagenary reading.
On bis, Commander Ji Gang of the Embroidered-Uniform Guard, guilty of crime, was executed.
On yisi, Embroidered-Uniform Guard Commander Ji Gang was executed for crimes.
Literal English should render 乙巳 as yisi.
In the ninth month, on maoyin, an earthquake struck the capital.
In the ninth month, on guimao, an earthquake struck the capital.
癸卯 is guimao, not maoyin.
Ninth month, on maoyin, the capital was shaken by earthquake.
Ninth month, on guimao, the capital shook with earthquake.
Literal English also misreads 癸卯 as maoyin.
In the lower month of winter, on dingchou, he encamped at Fengyang and offered sacrifice at the imperial mausolea.
In the tenth month of winter, on dingchou, he encamped at Fengyang and offered sacrifice at the imperial mausolea.
冬下月 is a corruption of 冬十月 (tenth month of winter), not a 'lower month'.
Winter, lower month, on dingchou, he halted at Fengyang and sacrificed at the imperial tombs.
Winter, tenth month, on dingchou, he halted at Fengyang and sacrificed at the imperial tombs.
Literal English should treat 下月 as 十月.
In the second month, on guihai, Zhu Gaochou, Prince of Gu, was stripped of rank and reduced to a commoner.
In the second month, on guihai, Zhu Hui, Prince of Gu, was stripped of rank and reduced to a commoner.
谷王橞 is Zhu Hui (橞), not Zhu Gaochou; Gaochou confuses him with the Gaoxu generation names.
Second month, on guihai, Prince of Gu Zhu Gaochou, guilty of crime, was deposed to commoner status.
Second month, on guihai, Prince Gu Hui was deposed to commoner status.
Literal English should identify 橞 as Hui.
In the eleventh month, on guiyou, Zhao Hu was moved from the Ministry of Rites to the Ministry of War and dispatched to review the welfare of frontier garrisons and their settled populations.
In the eleventh month, on guiyou, Zhao Yu was moved from the Ministry of Rites to the Ministry of War and dispatched to review the welfare of frontier garrisons and their settled populations.
趙羽 is Zhao Yu (羽), not Zhao Hu.
In the eleventh month, on guiyou, Minister of Rites Zhao Hu was made Minister of War and sent to inspect the gains and losses of garrison troops and civilians on the northern frontier.
In the eleventh month, on guiyou, Minister of Rites Zhao Yu was made Minister of War and sent to inspect the gains and losses of garrison troops and civilians on the northern frontier.
Literal English should likewise read 羽 as Yu.
On xinchou Earl Wang Tong of Chengshan rushed by relay to bring famine relief to Shaanxi.
On xinchou Marquis Wang Tong of Chengshan rushed by relay to bring famine relief to Shaanxi.
成山侯 is Marquis of Chengshan, not Earl; the English wrongly says Earl.
On xinchou, Chengshan Earl Wang Tong rode post-haste to relieve famine in Shaanxi.
On xinchou, Chengshan Marquis Wang Tong rode post-haste to relieve famine in Shaanxi.
Literal English should render 侯 as Marquis.
In the second month, on jiyou, the witch Tang Sai'er stirred up revolt at Botai, and Earl Liu Sheng of Anyuan marched against her.
In the second month, on jiyou, the witch Tang Sai'er stirred up revolt at Botai, and Marquis Liu Sheng of Anyuan marched against her.
安遠侯 is Marquis of Anyuan, not Earl.
Second month, on jiyou, the sorceress Tang Sai'er of Botai raised rebellion; Anyuan Earl Liu Sheng led troops to suppress her.
Second month, on jiyou, the sorceress Tang Sai'er of Botai raised rebellion; Anyuan Marquis Liu Sheng led troops to suppress her.
Literal English should render 侯 as Marquis.
In the twenty-first year, on yiwei of the first month of spring, the Emperor sacrificed to Heaven and Earth in the southern suburbs.
In the twenty-first year, on yiwei of the first month of spring, the Emperor offered the great suburban sacrifice to Heaven and Earth.
大禮天地 is a corruption of 大祀天地 (great sacrifice), not 'great ceremony'.
In the twenty-first year, spring, first month, on the day yiwei, performed the great sacrifice to Heaven and Earth at the southern suburb.
Year 21, spring first month, on yiwei, he greatly sacrificed to Heaven and Earth at the southern suburbs.
Literal English should reflect 祀 not 禮.
In the fifth month of summer, on guimao, land tax from the previous year was remitted for flood-stricken prefectures including Kaifeng, Nanyang, Weihui, and Fengyang.
In the fifth month of summer, on guiwei, land tax from the previous year was remitted for flood-stricken prefectures including Kaifeng, Nanyang, Weihui, and Fengyang.
癸未 is guiwei, not guimao (癸卯).
In the fifth month of summer, on the day guimao, remitted last year's land tax from flood-stricken prefectures including Kaifeng, Nanyang, Weihui, and Fengyang.
In the fifth month of summer, on the day guiwei, remitted last year's land tax from flood-stricken prefectures including Kaifeng, Nanyang, Weihui, and Fengyang.
Literal English should read 癸未 as guiwei.
On renshen Earl Li Bin of Fengcheng died in Jiaozhi.
On renshen Marquis Li Bin of Fengcheng died in Jiaozhi.
豐城侯 is Marquis, not Earl.
